requirements.requirement: The system must validate via unit tests that NPI credential data containing board certification strings is correctly extracted into the certification schema.
The system must validate via unit tests that extracted certifications are normalized into a consistent format for scoring.
The system must validate via unit tests that certifications matching the queried specialty produce a higher relevance score than non-matching certifications.
The system must validate via unit tests that multiple certifications are aggregated into a single relevance score according to the scoring contract.
The system must validate via integration tests that the board certification score is included in the evaluate_care_facade response payload.
The system must validate via integration tests that the certification list is present in the response payload alongside the computed score.
The system must validate via integration tests that the response structure for board certification matches the schema defined in EVAL-BOARD-ST-001.
The system must validate via unit tests that when no certifications exist in NPI data, the system returns an empty certification list and a neutral or zero relevance score.
The system must validate via unit tests that unrelated certifications produce a low or zero relevance score for the queried specialty.
The system must validate via unit tests that malformed or unexpected credential strings do not cause extraction or scoring failures.
The system must validate via integration tests that downstream consumers can access the board certification measure without errors when present.
The system must validate via integration tests that downstream consumers receive a valid response when the board certification measure is absent.
